name: thoughts
description: A Thoughts Library: documents, review cards and notes to the phone.

interface.longDescription: Read and search your Thoughts Library (LaTeX, Markdown and PDF documents), see your review cards with their answers and how you rated yourself, send a note with math to your phone to draw on and read your reply, propose edits to your notes, create, move and merge review cards, create Projects and move notes between them, and import a PDF from its URL.
defaultPrompt: Which review cards did I struggle with this week?
Explain the Results section of my latest paper.
Send me a sketch of this derivation to annotate.
